title: Affective Music Recommendation: A Rollout-Based World Model for Offline Preference Optimization
reviewer_a_dynamics: Models sequential listener preference dynamics for music recommendation.
reviewer_a_evaluation: Rollout-based recommendation performance is evaluated, but the environment is non-medical.
reviewer_a_rationale: The learned dynamics concern music recommendation rather than a medical, physiological, or health system.
reviewer_b_dynamics: A causal transformer rolls forward engagement, rating, valence, and arousal under candidate song recommendations.
reviewer_b_evaluation: Reports cold-start feedback prediction, five-song simulated rollouts, counterfactual stress tests, and policy comparisons.
reviewer_b_lineage: Distinct affective-health recommendation study; no duplicate record identified.
reviewer_b_rationale: The health-oriented rollout simulator and its policy use are empirically evaluated.

title: From language to world: Bridging LLMs and world models for intelligent surgery
reviewer_a_dynamics: Discusses connections between language models and surgical world models without presenting a learned dynamics study.
reviewer_a_evaluation: The official publisher record identifies the article as commentary and provides no primary empirical results.
reviewer_a_lineage: Single publisher commentary; no empirical publication lineage identified.
reviewer_a_rationale: This is a commentary rather than an eligible empirical study or structured review.
reviewer_b_dynamics: The accessible abstract discusses linking language and surgical world models, but methods could not be inspected.
reviewer_b_evaluation: The official publisher page did not provide sufficient primary methods and results for eligibility assessment.
reviewer_b_lineage: No duplicate identified from available metadata.
reviewer_b_rationale: Insufficient accessible full text prevents classification as empirical work or an eligible review.

title: Nonstationary Battery
reviewer_a_dynamics: Models nonstationary battery dynamics and control rather than a health or biomedical system.
reviewer_a_evaluation: The reported transition and policy evaluation concerns battery operation.
reviewer_a_lineage: Single stable Zenodo record; no duplicate candidate identified.
reviewer_b_dynamics: Updates a Beta-Bernoulli treatment-outcome world model online with posterior decay and uses it for active-inference action selection.
reviewer_b_evaluation: Runs nonstationary bandit, antimicrobial-resistance, and sepsis batteries with reward, optimal-action, and recovery comparisons.
reviewer_b_lineage: Distinct Zenodo study; candidate title is abbreviated but the DOI resolves to one stable report.
reviewer_b_rationale: An adaptive model used for medical action selection is empirically tested, including falsifying results.

title: Sonata: A Hybrid World Model for Inertial Kinematics under Clinical Data Scarcity
reviewer_a_dynamics: Uses a structured transition operator to predict future latent inertial-kinematic states.
reviewer_a_evaluation: A controlled suite includes horizon-48 signal forecast MAE alongside clinical and transfer probes.
reviewer_a_rationale: The physiological kinematics world model includes a direct future-signal evaluation of learned dynamics.
reviewer_b_dynamics: Predicts the latent state of the next IMU window with a linear transition head.
reviewer_b_evaluation: Evaluation emphasizes frozen clinical probes and latent structure; the model transition is not tested through its own rollout or state prediction output.
reviewer_b_lineage: Distinct Sonata study; no duplicate record identified.
reviewer_b_rationale: The predictive objective is used for representation learning without direct dynamics-capability evaluation.
